lead:
**લોકલપલ્સ** is a local-first ઇવેંટ ખોજ ઔર organiser platform મૈંને બનાયા કે સાથ **Next.js 15 App માર્ગr**, React 18, પ્રકારScript, Tailwind CSS, ઔર shadcn/ui. મૈંને બનાયા it in March 2026 — it's the most recent web પરિયોજના in મેરે portfolio. It uses local બ્રાઉજ઼ર storage as a zero-cost database backend alongside Firebase, ઔર is built as a **Progressive Web App** કે સાથ offline support ઔર an install prompt.

લોકલપલ્સ demonstrates a full-stack પ્રકારScript application કે સાથ authentication (Clerk), file-based routing, PDF ticket generation, calendar export (.ics), ઔર an admin panel — all in a modern serverless-ready architecture. Code is on [ગિટહબ](https://github.com/lingadevaru-hp/LocalPulse).

columns: મૈંને ઇસકા ઉપયોગ કિસ લિએ કિયા

rows.मैंने इसका उपयोग किस लिए किया: File-based routing, server ઔર client components, layouts
ઘટક library built on Radix UI primitives
End-to-end type safety — typed API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls
Sign in, sign up, profile, password reset — managed auth so I don't roll મેરે own
Zero-cost database — no backend server required
Install prompt, mobile icons, offline-capable pages

content.content:
**Event Discovery:** મૈંને બનાયા search ઔર filter by city, category, ઔર date. વિશેષતાd events section. Smart recommendations using category + city + rating affinity scoring. Access-controlled event visibility: local, college, department.

**Organiser Workflow:** Organiser verification via document upload (Aadhaar, PAN, GST, business docs). સ્થિતિ states: pending / approved / rejected. Admin review panel.

**Ticketing:** Downloadable PDF tickets named by event. Ticket history per user. Reminder toggles. Add-to-calendar export (.ics — Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar).

**Local Data Hub (/database):** Inspect all locally stored data, export backup JSON, import data on another device, clear all data. All of this runs without a server — the user's બ્રાઉજ઼ર is the database.

content.title: શૂન્ય-લાગત આર્કિટેક્ચર મેરે લિએ ક્યોં માયને રખતા હૈ
content.content: Using local બ્રાઉજ઼ર storage as the primary database means no database hosting costs. Firebase supplements this કે લિએ features requiring server-side persistence. The entire platform runs at near-zero cost — important when I'm shipping personal પરિયોજનાs without a budget.

rows.उद्देश्य: Home / ઇવેંટ ખોજ કે સાથ recommendations
User ticket history ઔર PDF download
Admin control panel — organiser approval, analytics
Local Data Hub — inspect, export, import, clear

sections.title: યહ મેરે કામ મેં કૈસે ફિટ બૈઠતા હૈ

content.content:
લોકલપલ્સ contrasts sharply કે સાથ મેરે [[fraud-detection|ધોખાધડ઼ી પહચાન પ્રણાલી]] in approach: where fraud detection used a traditional server-side stack (ASP.NET, SQL Server), લોકલપલ્સ embraces the modern serverless React ecoસિસ્ટમ (Next.js App માર્ગr, Clerk managed auth, Firebase, edge deployment).

The પરિયોજના demonstrates પ્રકારScript across a full-stack application — type-safe API routes, typed React components, typed Firebase calls — rather than the JavaScript-without-types approach common in quick prototypes. It's the closest thing I have to a 'standard' full-stack web પરિયોજના, compared to મેરે blockchain ઔર infrastructure work.
